headline: The feature works, but current image loading and encoding choices introduce avoidable performance risk.

findings.point: src/pages/work.astro:71 sets loading="lazy" for all case images, including the first one that is likely in or near the initial viewport; this can delay LCP at page load.
src/pages/work.astro:64-72 uses <Image> with PNG sources and no explicit modern output strategy; this commonly ships larger payloads than necessary for non-transparent content.

src/assets/images/work-contract-intelligence.png:1, src/assets/images/work-swimtrack.png:1, src/assets/images/work-ai-council.png:1 add new binary assets with no visible size guardrail, increasing risk of oversized source images and heavier build artifacts.

suggestions: Make the first image eager (and optionally high fetch priority), keep later images lazy.
Use modern formats (e.g., via Picture/webp/avif pipeline) and verify byte savings against current output.
Add a CI image budget check (max source dimensions/file size) to prevent regressions.

headline: Adding static images to portfolio page with Astro’s built-in Image component; no injection or trust-boundary risks.
Image component usage and asset handling introduce layout shift and unoptimized binary delivery risks.

findings.point: Image lacks width/height props; only CSS height:auto at src/pages/work.astro:118-124 triggers CLS on slow loads
PNG binaries added raw with no format conversion or size caps; astro:assets Image at src/pages/work.astro:66-73 won't auto-optimize without config
Alt texts exceed 200 chars and contain narrative dashes; src/pages/work.astro:9,15,22 risk truncation or poor a11y
All three images use loading=lazy even if first case renders above fold; src/pages/work.astro:70

suggestions: Add explicit width/height or aspect-ratio to Image
Configure image service for WebP/AVIF output
Shorten alt texts to factual descriptions
